purpose: Present the selected vehicle's personalized range estimates, learned efficiency evidence, scenario projections and interactive what-if calculation.
primaryGoal: Understand likely driving range and how speed, temperature, battery capacity and driving conditions affect it, without confusing estimates with measurements.

dataSources.name: Range projection snapshot
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for a nonempty vehicle ID; forwards the query AbortSignal. One shared payload feeds seven projection-data sections; tips are static localized advice and AI is independent. No selected date bounds are sent.
dataSources.unitsEvidence: useAnalytics.ts:385-400 documents distances in kilometres, speed in km/h, efficiency in Wh/km and temperature in Celsius; RangeSummary.tsx:12-15 and RangeCurve.tsx:26-27 convert distance to metres before display helpers. This audit preserves the current wire shape and does not certify backend units.
dataSources.scopeEvidence: RangeSummary.tsx:34-38 explicitly describes a current-state/driving-history snapshot rather than a selected date window.
dataSources.backendLimits: Router registration and frontend contract inspected; handler calculations, database filtering, payload examples and cache behavior were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle selection
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle scope, persisted selection and first known vehicle resolve through the existing owner; page adds no second selector. The hook returns no loading/error state to this caller.
dataSources.backendLimits: The vehicles endpoint request was inspected; its backend route and response were not independently validated in this bounded audit.

dataSources.name: Optional AI range-model narrative
dataSources.behavior: Explicit user-started stream; canPredictRange requires a finite positive ID; scopeKey changes with the vehicle. withAiFeature('range-prediction-model') prevents mounting the inner stream while disabled. AIFeatureCard disables duplicate starts while streaming and forwards text/error/activity/usage to the output owner.
dataSources.backendLimits: router.go:5086 passes RangePrediction into another router; the exact POST route registration was not resolved. A scoped search of internal\api\ai failed because that directory does not exist; no endpoint reachability or training/persistence behavior is claimed.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep these domain adapters and reuse existing feedback; do not create another page-wide state engine.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain local domain rendering and existing LayoutCard owner; consolidate only if concrete independent consumer evidence warrants it.

issues.detail: Page passes query but not loading or busy to PageLayout. PageContainer's aria-busy and useLoadAnnouncement read explicit loading/busy/error props, not query, so the inspected call does not connect projection loading to that page-level announcement path.
issues.fix: Use the existing busy/announcement contract without setting full-page loading that would replace all children. Preserve progressive sections and optional AI independence; verify actual live-region behavior before claiming a11y acceptance.

accessibility.limits: Keyboard navigation, actual focus restoration, accessible matrix reading order, chart data-view reachability, touch operation, contrast, forced colors, screen readers and reduced-motion behavior were not exercised.

states.noVehicle: ProjectedRangePage.tsx:39-49 renders a localized selection notice; header owns the action. useSelectedVehicle does not expose vehicle-list loading/failure here, so unresolved/failed fleet loading can share this presentation with no selection.
states.initialLoading: RangeSourceSlot.tsx:14 preserves section skeleton geometry; RangeSummary.tsx:33 suppresses readings during initial loading. Page does not replace all content with a single loading gate.
states.emptyUnavailable: Each section uses its own missing predicate and localized explanation; summary metrics use null rather than fabricated zero. Tips remain available for a selected vehicle independent of projection success.
states.fatalError: RangeSourceSlot.tsx:15 and RangeSummary.tsx:27-30 render QueryError with source.retry; neighboring AI and tips remain mounted.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: useDataState.ts:37-52 forwards query data/error/fetch status. dataState.ts:166-172 documents retained-data failure/paused handling; SourceTrustNotice.tsx:8 delegates retained warnings.
states.offlineInitial: SourceTrustNotice.tsx:9-18 renders a paused request notice and retry action rather than claiming loaded measurements.
states.partialMissing: knownNumber and safeArray distinguish missing numeric inputs and lists. Calculator only runs with known battery/capacity, but its existing efficiency fallback still produces a modeled estimate when a matrix bucket is missing.
states.ai: withAiFeature.tsx:46-48 hides the inner feature when disabled; AIRangePrediction.tsx:39-40 gates invalid vehicle IDs; AIFeatureCard.tsx:259-260,297-299 prevents another start during streaming. Output lifecycle rendering is delegated to AiOutputPanel and was not separately audited.

issues.detail: interpolateRange uses a deterministic efficiency formula for a missing bucket and 170 Wh/km for invalid/nonpositive efficiency, but its return value carries no indication of learned versus fallback provenance. RangeCalculator presents both results through the same numeric display.
issues.fix: Preserve the formula, clamping, rounding and all existing output values. Add explicit local provenance/reason metadata and localized fallback context so users can distinguish an estimate from learned evidence; do not remove the calculator or invent measured data.

issues.detail: The no-active-ID branch cannot distinguish unresolved vehicle loading, failed fleet lookup and genuinely empty fleet because it receives only the selected ID.
issues.fix: If integration requires distinct feedback, extend/reuse the existing selected-vehicle source contract rather than adding a duplicate fleet fetch or local vehicle picker; keep the current prompt and shared header ownership.

states.limits: No states were mounted or network responses simulated. Source handling is not proof of runtime recovery, cancellation or retained-data correctness.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / mission 43 neon and saturated decoration
visualIssues.detail: Retained exported effColor returns bg-neon-green, bg-neon-amber, bg-emerald-500 and bg-red-500 at lines 8-11. Production matrix cells use matrixTone instead, so visible neon in the mounted matrix is not established. Page still publicly re-exports effColor at line 22.
visualIssues.fix: Preserve exported helper compatibility and thresholds while adopting existing semantic severity tones through an explicitly coordinated consumer review; do not assert an active visual defect or delete the export.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 accent and fixed hue noise
visualIssues.detail: Shared AI action hardcodes cyan border, background, text and focus colors; badge at line 214 also hardcodes cyan styling. These bypass neutral/semantic theme variables. No rendered saturation or contrast failure was measured.
visualIssues.fix: Shared AI owner should use restrained existing semantic tokens for badge/action states while preserving Helix identity, labels, streaming/disabled behavior and current props; do not patch this page independently.

visualIssues.detail: Slider uses fixed accent-cyan-500 and ring-cyan-500 at lines 119-120 rather than the existing theme accent. This is a shared source-level color consistency risk, not measured fluorescent UI.
visualIssues.fix: Shared Slider owner should reuse the existing semantic accent/focus tokens and retain a visible focus indicator, native semantics and forced-color behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Eight domain components import LayoutCard/ChartCard from @/components/layout/layout-reference rather than @/components/layout; RangeSummary additionally imports StatMetric from the stat-reference subpath. Page itself already uses the layout category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Switch only feature callers to established layout/data-display category exports while retaining the existing implementations and props; do not create replacements or change shared internal import policy.

architectureIssues.detail: Localized speed tip embeds '110 km/h' rather than using the same selected speed formatter as calculator/scenarios. The message's numerical advice is preserved but its unit display ignores the user's speed preference.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the 110 km/h-equivalent advice, format 110/3.6 m/s with existing useUnits and interpolate a localized placeholder using the canonical catalog owner. Do not change the recommendation or wire/cache values.

architectureIssues.detail: Header comment cites GET /vehicles/{id}/range/projection, while this page calls /analytics/range-projection and router.go:3343 exposes a different vehicle-scoped path (/battery/projected-range). The comment is not reliable endpoint evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: AI owner should correct the comment to the actual inspected page endpoint without changing routing or trainer behavior.

priority.rationale: The page is already decomposed with source-trust adapters, existing layouts, restrained local surfaces and unit-aware displays. Prioritize estimate provenance, page loading announcement wiring and shared Slider target/color treatment; then finish category import and localized tip consistency. No runtime breakage or visual acceptance is asserted.

competingImplementations.name: effColor versus matrixTone
competingImplementations.detail: Two color mappings retain the same efficiency thresholds; matrixTone is used by current matrix cells, effColor remains a public compatibility export. Other effColor consumers were not searched because they are outside this page dependency scope.
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse semantic matrixTone; preserve exported API until its owner coordinates compatibility. No replacement universal palette is needed.

competingImplementations.name: Range model fallback versus optional AI learned-envelope narrative
competingImplementations.detail: AI description explicitly compares learned buckets with the static heuristic projection. These are distinct existing capabilities, not permission to replace projection calculations with AI.
competingImplementations.decision: Keep both capabilities and their separate query/user-action lifecycles; make estimate provenance clear.
